title: Combination gate
statement: Let $y_{\mathrm{base}}$, $f_{\mathrm{base}}$, $m$, and $p$ be natural numbers, and let $c$ be a function from natural numbers to natural numbers. Define a gate of type AND whose two input vertices are $y_{\mathrm{base}}+\max(2^m+p-1,0)$ and $f_{\mathrm{base}}+c(p)$.
hypotheses_covered: A function $c$ from natural numbers to natural numbers
